# Record and monitor

*On the intercom · 7 of 34*

REC saves audio; MON hears every DMR call.

## Record

REC records everything received on the channel to Download/DMR/Audio. Play them from Last heard → Recordings.

## Monitor

MON tells the radio to pass every digital call it can decode on the channel, not only those addressed to you or to the talkgroups in the channel's list. On the firmware the phone shipped with, that is the radio's own monitor mode. Receiving every call whatever its talkgroup (promiscuous receive) is not available yet: no module firmware has been proven to admit such calls on the air, so MON on a DMR channel behaves as on the firmware the phone shipped with, with every firmware. MON is for the current channel: changing channel (arrows, scan, zone, the car) switches MON off, as the radio does, and the button goes dark.
